dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: As you've seen, I'm a writer of fan novels.

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: I'm decently well-known in fan work circles, and I was approached some time back by an editor from Yae Publishing House, who asked if I was willing to try working on an original project.

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: I did try, of course, but I found that it's just... not that interesting, you know? I just love doing fan work more!

dialogues.speaker: Ishida
dialogues.text: Of course, some readers did comment that I might just be afraid of change and progress, but to me, it's just that creating should be about happiness.
